title: Implement the serving-owned ingest target

gates.name: Python typecheck
gates.command: docker compose run --rm --no-deps backend python -m mypy src/face_moment

gates.name: Ingest target tests
gates.command: docker compose run --rm backend python -m pytest tests/serving_control/test_ingest_target.py

evidence_required: FT-001-AC-010 RED: serving_control cannot publish an immutable ingest target for an active СПА with valid timezone and already eligible serving revision; GREEN: its owner-backed configuration/test path resolves that target while rejecting unknown, inactive, invalid-timezone and ineligible targets before object or Photo persistence; decisive comparison: accepted and rejected projections match the canonical target rules and no foreign state changes; artifact: isolated migration/repository/application output.
purpose: Supply the immutable serving context that inventory must validate before staging or admitting a photographer JPEG.
success_outcome: serving_control can publish an immutable IngestTarget only for an active configured СПА with a valid timezone and already eligible serving revision.
anti_goals: Do not implement operator settings UI, active search date, automatic rollover or serving-revision switching.
Do not create production СПА or revision seed identities.

forbidden_scope: Photo admission or processing-owned state writes
stop_conditions: The accepted serving_control ownership or ingest-target fields would need to change.
Resolving a target would require direct processing writes or model execution.
The task expands into manual serving-revision lifecycle or public UI.

constraints: serving_control owns СПА configuration and target publication under src/face_moment/serving_control/.
The revision reference uses deliberate RESTRICT/no-cascade behavior and consumes processing eligibility without writing it.
The owner-backed path is for pilot configuration and isolated tests, not a production seed or settings framework.
invariants: Unknown, inactive or invalid targets fail before object or Photo persistence.
The photographer-selected visit_date remains input to admission and is never replaced by the target provider.
Inventory and transport cannot write serving-control state directly.
verification_targets: Isolated migration/repository/application proof covers valid target publication, IANA timezone validation, eligible revision use and rejected target classes.
